title: Fixed-field naturality of the completed tensor component
statement: Fix l,X,R,closed,models as in def-sf-adic-completed-tensor-stage-component and a finite coefficient stage E with a single finite model N. The components completedTensorStageComponent at E are natural for every pair of rational constructible E-morphisms, after inclusion in the common-stage category. This statement uses no coefficient enlargement and compares no two finite models.

source.place: BS Definition 3.4.10 and Remark 6.8.15; HRS Proposition 5.2 and Lemma 7.9; the corresponding part of the finite normalized realization argument.

proof.text: Apply completedTensorIntegralComponent_natural_iso to get the natural isomorphism after precomposition by the product of the raw scalar localizations. These localizations are categorical localizations at the rationalization morphism property, hence their product is a localization. Full faithfulness of precomposition descends the integral natural isomorphism. Every rational object is the localization of its underlying integral object, so the descended components are precisely completedTensorIntegralComponent. Whisker the existing commonInclusionTensorComparison by ordinary and compose. Its naturality gives exactly the stated equation for completedTensorStageComponent.

theorem completedTensorStageComponent_naturality
    (E : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l (PadicAlgCl l))
    (N : CompletedTensorFiniteModel l X R closed models E)
    {P Q : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l
        (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X ×
      sfRationalConstructibleCategory l
        (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X}
    (f : P ⟶ Q) :
    let I := GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
      (l := l) (Ω := PadicAlgCl l) (Y := X) E
    (((ordinary l X R).prod (ordinary l X R)) ⋙ closed.tensor).map
        ((I.prod I).map f) ≫
        (completedTensorStageComponent l X R closed models E N Q.1 Q.2).hom =
      (completedTensorStageComponent l X R closed models E N P.1 P.2).hom ≫
        (commonStageDerivedTensor l (PadicAlgCl l) X ⋙ ordinary l X R).map
          ((I.prod I).map f)
